description: PERMANENTLY delete an app and all its files. This is the most destructive call in this server and it cannot be undone: the files, the version history, the room data, the community entries and the users' saved data all go. Deletes that app for good. Its code can be taken out first (neblla_versions migrate, or neblla_git); paying customers lose their entitlements, so refunds are settled in Stripe beforehand. Neblla itself cancels the app's Pro subscription and its users' subscriptions, removes its custom domain and its history. A Google Play listing is on the developer's own Play account and stays: the answer's `left` names it. An app can also stop being hosted here without being deleted: its own HTML can be served from its own domain while Neblla stays the backend (neblla_update_app addDomain).
name: neblla_delete_app
title: Delete app
